hero.headline: The logistics bridge for your students. Grow your international enrolments.
hero.subhead: Kimere is a facilitation and consulting hub — the operational bridge between universities, the ground in the destination country, and the agencies that recruit the students. You keep the marketing, the recruitment and the relationship with the family. We take the part that makes the corridor expensive: the file, the consulate, the funding, the arrival.

segments.heading: A university and an agency are not asking us the same question.
segments.body: One wants enrolments from markets it cannot service after the offer letter goes out. The other wants a partner on the ground it doesn't have to become itself. The answer is genuinely different, so we've stopped writing one page for both.

universities.heading: Your international office stops at the offer letter. That's where candidates fall out.
universities.body: Almost nothing that loses you an international candidate happens during admission. It happens afterwards, in the administrative gap between the offer and the first lecture — and your office was never staffed to fill it, in every timezone, in every language. That gap is the whole of what we do.

points.title: The individual admin your office can't absorb
points.body: Residence permit filings, tax codes, registered residence, health cover, housing disputes — one student at a time, off your team's desk, and never presenting ourselves as the university.

points.title: Funding questions answered with sources attached
points.body: What a candidate in a given country will actually pay once income-based funding is counted, answered from published sources your office can forward to the family without checking it first.

points.title: One counterpart, in the candidate's own language
points.body: Where our team covers the country you're recruiting from, that's who takes the call — with your office, and with the family. It's the same conversation, minus the interpreter and the misunderstanding.

agencies.heading: The relationship stays yours. The ground is ours.
agencies.body: We work as your destination partner in Italy, not as a competing agency. You run marketing, recruitment and the relationship with the family in your own market — the part you're good at, and the part that cost you money to build. When pre-enrolment opens on Universitaly the file passes to us and stays with a dedicated coordinator until the student is enrolled, in order with their permit, and settled. You get updates the whole way, and the student stays yours.

agencies.commitmentsHeading: What goes in the agreement, because you're going to ask
commitments: We don't market to your students and we won't recruit in your market. Our acquisition happens here, or through you.
The student stays your client for the duration of the agreement. We report to you, not around you.
Commercial terms — sub-agency status, commission split, payment points — are agreed in writing before the first student is referred, not settled afterwards.
You get a dedicated coordinator with a direct contact, not a shared inbox and a ticket number.

steps.title: A first conversation
steps.body: Your current volumes, the destinations you already serve, and whether Italy suits the students you actually recruit. Half an hour, and if it doesn't suit them we say so.

steps.title: The boundary, in writing
steps.body: Exactly where your work ends and ours begins, what we report and how often, and the commercial terms in black and white. Nothing about the split is left to be defined later.

steps.title: A small first group
steps.body: A few students, run end to end, so both teams watch the process work on real files with real deadlines before anyone commits to volume.

steps.title: A formal agreement
steps.body: Signed once the pilot has confirmed the model works — on terms based on what that first group actually showed, not on what either side forecast.

seminar.heading: The first online seminar is free — and it's built on your market, not on ours.
seminar.body: We connect with your team and model the session on the problem you actually have. If your students are looking at Italy, we take your office through scholarships, tuition brackets and the ISEE. If they're looking at France, we go and research France and come back with that. Either way you get a session that answers your questions rather than ours, and you keep what comes out of it.
points: Built on the destination you care about, whether that's Italy or not
Funding, fees and qualification recognition answered from published sources
No cost and no commitment on the first session
A written summary your office keeps, whatever you decide afterwards

steps.title: You tell us where your students want to go
steps.body: The destination, the level, and the questions your office keeps having to answer without a reliable source. That's the whole brief we need.

steps.title: We research that market, not a generic one
steps.body: If it's a country we run ourselves you get what we know first-hand. If it isn't, we go and research it properly — and we say which of the two you're getting.

steps.title: The session, with your team
steps.body: Online, an hour or so, with the people who'll have to use the answers in the room. Questions during, not at the end.

steps.title: The written summary
steps.body: Yours to keep and to circulate internally, with the sources attached. No follow-up sequence you didn't ask for.

seminar.note: One session, no cost, no commitment — and no obligation to become a partner afterwards. If all you ever take from us is the summary, that's a fair outcome.

obstacle.heading: Why a foreign university stops at Italy — and what closes the gap
obstacle.body: The question we get asked most often by an international office isn't about Italian universities. It's some version of "we can't tell a family what this will cost". Funding here is income-based and runs through an indicator almost nobody outside the country has heard of, so the number that decides the whole decision is the one nobody in the room can produce. An unknown cost is worse than a high one — and the corridor never opens.

fears.title: Nobody can tell the family what it will actually cost
fears.body: Published tuition is a band, not a price, and the band moves with declared household income. Quote the top of it and the family walks away from a course they could nearly have had for free.
fears.answer: We produce the real figure for a specific candidate profile, with the public source behind it, so your office can send it to the family without checking it first.

fears.title: The ISEE is a black box
fears.body: The income indicator that decides funding and tuition has to be rebuilt from payslips and tax returns issued in another country and another language. It's the single most common reason a candidate never files at all.
fears.answer: We reconstruct it with the family, document by document, and file on its own deadline — which is not the university's and does not wait for it.

fears.title: Recognition of the qualification looks like a wall
fears.body: A foreign diploma has to arrive in Italian and legally valid, and the sequence is long enough that offices assume it can't be done inside an admission cycle.
fears.answer: We build the file, keep the translation in-house and work backwards from the admission cut-off. The comparability statement itself is still issued by CIMEA or assessed by the university — nothing we do replaces it, and anyone who tells you otherwise is selling a rejected application.

pricing.heading: Two prices, both published. Build your own margin on top of ours.
pricing.body: An agency has to know its landed cost per file before it can quote its own client, and a university wants to see what the reserved rate is actually worth. Neither question survives "contact us for a quote", so here are both figures.

plans.name: All-Inclusive, per student
plans.body: The full ground package for one student you send to Italy. It's a fixed cost per file, which means you know your margin before you quote the family rather than after.
includes: Housing search, lease reviewed before signature, registration
The visa file, prepared to the standard of that consulate
The scholarship application, filed on its own deadline
Someone physically with the student on the ground
Health cover arranged and in force
plans.note: Priced for Italy, which is the market where we run the route ourselves and can be physically present. For other destinations we quote per case, because what we can genuinely do on the ground changes with the country.

plans.name: Consultation, partner rate
plans.body: The same strategic consultation a student books, at the rate reserved for partner institutions — for the cases where your office wants a specific candidate profile worked through rather than a market explained.
includes: The preliminary questionnaire and our reading of it
Research on the specific case, done before the session
The session itself, in a language your team is comfortable in
A written summary, yours to keep
plans.note: $20 below the public rate. The first seminar stays free and is separate from this: you don't have to buy anything to have that conversation.

pricing.compareLabel: See the public rate on the students page
pricing.billingNote: Both figures are in US dollars. Before anything is invoiced we confirm to you in writing the exact amount, the currency you'll be billed in and the tax treatment that applies — no engagement starts on the strength of a number on a web page.
pricing.limitsHeading: What a fee does not buy — better said now than in month three
limits: Not a guarantee of a visa, of admission or of a scholarship. Those decisions belong to consulates, universities and funding bodies alone, and any partner promising you otherwise is selling something they can't deliver.
University fees, official translation charges and government fees are paid to those bodies, not to us — they are not inside the per-student fee.
We're not a licensed estate agency. We view, verify and register housing; we don't hold listings and we don't take deposits on anyone's behalf.

Commercial terms — sub-agency status, commission split, payment points — are set in writing before the first student is referred. The published fee is the starting point of that conversation, not the end of it.

dueDiligence.heading: Due diligence, up front
items: Kimere began operating in June 2026 and the legal structure is being formalised. We share current company documentation directly at the due-diligence stage rather than describe it here.

We hold no formal agreement or accreditation with any Italian university or public body. Where a page on this site describes what a university or a consulate does, it links to that institution's own published source.
We don't issue visas or residence permits and we don't guarantee outcomes. Those decisions belong to the consulate and the Questura.
We're not a licensed estate agency. We view, verify and register housing; we don't hold listings or take deposits on anyone's behalf.

form.heading: Book the free seminar
form.body: The same form handles a partnership enquiry — the "what are you looking for" field decides which conversation you get. It reaches the person who would run the partnership, not a sales queue. Tell us your volumes and your markets and you get a straight answer on whether the model fits, including when it doesn't.
